## Parental OpControl 0.17.6

- Luna chat bubbles now wrap every line to the bubble width and grow to show the whole reply. The inner horizontal scroller that clipped long lines and produced a scrollbar inside a bubble is gone; only the chat list scrolls.
- Cause: the bubble body was wrapped in a horizontal `ScrollViewer`, which measures its child with an infinite width, and the markdown text block did not wrap. The renderer now measures against the bubble width and the text blocks wrap.
- Inline math is larger (its stacked fractions are about the size of the body text), and display math is larger and centred.
- Fraction pictures draw the approved pieces: `[[bar a/b]]` and `[[bars …]]` show every piece divider with the shaded pieces in the subject colour, and `[[pie a/b]]` shows all slices. The stacked fraction caption is centred under the picture at about 20 px.
- Tables wrap inside the bubble instead of scrolling sideways.
- This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated. Luna stays enabled with the same key.
